'''Tacquet''' is a small, bowl-shaped [[Impact crater|crater]] that lies near the southern edge of [[Mare Serenitatis]], in the northeast part of the Moon. The surface near the crater is marked by high-[[albedo]] ejecta. To the west is a system of [[rille]]s designated the Rimae Menelaus. It was named after [[Duchy of Brabant|Brabantian]] mathematician [[André Tacquet]] (1612-1660).<ref>{{gpn|5816}}</ref>

==Satellite craters==
[[File:Tacquet sattelite craters map.jpg|thumb|left|Satellite craters of Tacquet]]
By convention these features are identified on lunar maps by placing the letter on the side of the crater midpoint that is closest to Tacquet.
